tests.name: IELTS — International English Language Testing System
tests.conductingBody: British Council / IDP / Cambridge Assessment English
acceptedBy: 10,000+ institutions worldwide including UK, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, US
tests.frequency: Multiple dates per month at test centres across Pakistan

syllabus.subject: Listening
topics: Conversations and monologues in everyday contexts
Following instructions and identifying key information

syllabus.subject: Reading
topics: Reading for gist and main ideas
Reading for detail and specific information
Understanding logical argument and writer opinion

howToApply: Register on the British Council or IDP website
Choose test type (Academic or General Training)
Select test date and centre in Pakistan
Pay the test fee and confirm your booking
tests.note: MCQ mock covers Listening (40) + Reading (40) only. Writing and Speaking are not auto-graded — practice offline with official prompts.

tests.name: SAT — Scholastic Assessment Test
acceptedBy: 4,000+ colleges and universities in the US and abroad
tests.fee: USD 60 (approx. PKR 16,680 at 2026 rates); additional fees for international test centres
tests.frequency: 7 times per year (March, May, June, August, October, November, December)

syllabus.subject: Reading & Writing
topics: Information and ideas: reading comprehension, main ideas, details, inferences
Craft and structure: vocabulary in context, text structure, purpose
Expression of ideas: rhetoric, organization, transitions
Standard English conventions: grammar, punctuation, usage

syllabus.subject: Math
topics: Problem-solving and data analysis: ratios, proportions, statistics
Geometry and trigonometry: circles, triangles, trigonometric ratios

howToApply: Create a College Board account at sat.org
Register for a test date and select a test centre in Pakistan
Upload a photo and pay the registration fee
Download your admission ticket before test day
tests.note: Digital SAT format (2024+). All sections are MCQ and fully auto-gradeable. SAT reports a 200–800 scale per section; your percentage here is a practice estimate.

tests.name: TOEFL iBT — Test of English as a Foreign Language
acceptedBy: 11,500+ institutions in 160+ countries including the US, Canada, UK, Australia
tests.frequency: Multiple dates per month at test centres across Pakistan + Home Edition
howToApply: Create an ETS account and register for TOEFL iBT
Select a test centre in Pakistan or choose the Home Edition
Pay the test fee and confirm registration
Take the test at the centre or from home
tests.note: MCQ mock covers Reading (20) + Listening (28) only. Speaking and Writing are not auto-graded — practice offline with official prompts.

tests.name: GRE — Graduate Record Examination
acceptedBy: Thousands of graduate and business schools worldwide
tests.frequency: Multiple dates per year at test centres across Pakistan + at-home testing
howToApply: Create an ETS account and register for the GRE
Select a test centre in Pakistan or choose at-home testing
Pay the test fee and confirm registration
Download the ETS browser for at-home testing
tests.note: MCQ mock covers Verbal (27) + Quantitative (27) only. Analytical Writing is not auto-graded — practice offline with official prompts.

tests.name: GMAT — Graduate Management Admission Test
tests.frequency: Year-round at test centres + online (GMAT Focus Edition)
howToApply: Create a GMAC account at mba.com
Register for GMAT Focus Edition
Select a test centre in Pakistan or schedule online
Pay the test fee and confirm
tests.note: GMAT Focus Edition format: Quantitative (21) + Verbal (23) + Data Insights (20). All sections are auto-graded in this mock.

tests.name: PTE Academic — Pearson Test of English
acceptedBy: 3,000+ institutions globally including UK, Australia, New Zealand, Canada
tests.frequency: Year-round at test centres across Pakistan + at-home testing

syllabus.subject: Reading
topics: Reading and writing fill in the blanks
Multiple choice single and multiple answer

howToApply: Create a Pearson PTE account and register
Select a test centre in Pakistan or choose at-home
Pay the test fee and confirm registration
Complete the test day check-in procedures
tests.note: MCQ mock covers Reading (20) + Listening (20) only. Speaking and Writing are not auto-graded — practice offline with official prompts.

tests.name: Duolingo English Test

syllabus.subject: Overview
topics: Computer-adaptive format — difficulty adjusts in real time based on performance
Not replicable as a static mock exam
Visit englishtest.duolingo.com for the official free practice test

howToApply: Create an account at englishtest.duolingo.com
Ensure you have a computer with a camera and microphone
Take the test anytime from home with proctoring
Share your verified score with institutions for free
tests.note: Computer-adaptive test — not replicable as a static mock. Visit englishtest.duolingo.com for the official practice test.

tests.name: ACT — American College Test
acceptedBy: All US colleges and universities that accept the SAT
tests.fee: USD 68 (approx. PKR 18,900 at 2026 rates); USD 103 with writing
tests.frequency: 6 times per year (usually September, October, December, February, April, June)
howToApply: Create a MyACT account
Register for a test date and select a centre
Upload a photo and pay the test fee
Download your admission ticket
tests.note: MCQ mock covers English (75) + Math (60) + Reading (40) + Science (40). The optional Writing essay is not auto-graded.
